Marvel Meow is fond of its name, and of the monk who gave it.
The monk once said that all the cats living on Jadebrook Mountain had a touch of the divine.
He also said Marvel Meow was the cleverest, most gifted, most marvelous one he'd ever met.
Marvel Meow is proud. It roams through the woods day and night, chasing the sun and moon, listening to the worldly sound... All these make it a marvelous Meow Meow!
But even a marvelous Meow Meow has things it can't figure out. Why hasn't the monk shown up for so long?
It doesn't know where he's gone, so it stays put and waits, year after year... Hmph! It isn't that it misses him. It just has nothing better to do, that's all.
Besides, it has its silly little sister for company, and there are always plenty of interesting cats in the forest. Life is far from boring! Look, those three on the stage are starting their show again!
